reviews.title: Best value for an aio cooler!
reviews.comment: Awesome cooler!  The rim style cooler block looks and works great with my sim racing rig.  Very quiet and keeps my CPU perfectly cool.  Highly recommended!
reviews.author: J. K. Shutz

reviews.title: Easy install
reviews.comment: Easy and straightforward install. It only just barely fit into my build so definitely double check if you were using pcpartpicker to plan out your build. However the cooler itself has been working great and for the price it is very solid
reviews.author: Joseph Suzuki

reviews.title: The Perfect AIO
reviews.comment: Great AIO! Very very quiet with a great aesthetic. The price is impossible to beat for the quality and performance. It keeps my Ryzen 7 7700 around 55°-70°C under load which is incredible! I will be buying a lot more of these for the PCs I build for my customers. Would love a sponsorship if yall offer those!! 🤣
reviews.author: Brady
